title: Hephaestus learning bundle, format version 1
description: A portable download of one person's learning. It carries only the person's own words, text that the person confirmed word for word, and closed fields. It names no workspace, no piece of work and no other person. A later format version gets its own file, so this file does not change after release. A reader also refuses a bundle that this schema cannot check: a file larger than 33554432 bytes (refused before it is parsed), an object with a duplicate key, a portableId that occurs more than once across records, growthPoints and tombstones, a date or time that does not exist (such as February 30), a record whose revisedAt is before its createdAt, an occurredWeek that its year does not have, and text with an unpaired surrogate. A writer puts in records only text that names no other person, and in a HEPHAESTUS record only the exact text that the person confirmed. A reader treats authorKind, madeBy and origin as claims of the issuing instance, never as proof.

format.description: Identifies the file as a Hephaestus learning bundle.

formatVersion.description: The format version. A reader refuses a version that it does not know.

bundleId.description: New for each download. With instanceId, it lets an import recognize a bundle that it already read.

instanceId.description: The stable id of the Hephaestus instance that issued the bundle.

generatedAt.description: When the instance generated the bundle.

records.description: The person's records that may leave the instance.

growthPoints.description: The person's growth points for practices with a portable identity.

tombstones.description: Records and growth points that an earlier bundle from this instance could carry and that this bundle does not.

portableId.description: Stable across downloads from one instance. It never changes for the life of the record or the growth point.

revision.description: Grows whenever any value that a bundle carries for the item changes, also its state, its close reason or its restoration after a withdrawal. A reader keeps the highest revision of one portableId. On equal revisions, a tombstone wins over the item.

origin.description: Where an imported item first came from. An instance that imported the item copies it unchanged into each later bundle, so an import recognizes the item again through any number of instances.

practiceKey.description: The portable identity of a practice, in the form <domain>/<slug>. A practice of one workspace has no portable identity and never appears.

record.description: A record in the person's own words, at its confirmed revision.

state.description: A record that waits for the person's review has no confirmed revision and never appears.

closeReason.description: Why the person closed the record. Present exactly when the state is CLOSED.

authorKind.description: PERSON: the person wrote the text. HEPHAESTUS: Hephaestus wrote the text and the person confirmed it word for word. A record that Hephaestus noted and the person did not keep never appears.

practiceKeys.description: The portable practices that the record names. Links to a practice of one workspace are left out.

helpPreference.description: For a goal only: the help that the person chose for this goal.

revisedAt.description: When the person confirmed this revision.

growthPoint.description: One outcome for one piece of work and one practice. It does not identify the piece of work or the workspace.

madeBy.description: Only REVIEW counts in totals. An IMPORT point carries its origin.

occurredWeek.description: The ISO 8601 week of the outcome.

tombstone.description: A record or growth point that an earlier bundle could carry and this one does not. It keeps no content.

reason.description: DELETED: the person deleted it. WITHDRAWN: it still exists but may no longer leave the instance, for example after a recall or a narrower export policy. A reader removes the item in both cases, and only the person's deletion is reported as a deletion.

revision.description: Higher than every revision of the item that a bundle could carry before it was deleted or withdrawn.

at.description: When it was deleted or withdrawn.
